why: FOLD is a brand campaign: silent app footage from the campaign Resources, so each clip is a short voice-over script (reviewer, 2026-10-27) on one of the brief's content angles. No future-value claims, no 'worth more than points', no competitor names, qualifiers kept, US audience. Disclosure burned in under the title.

brand_clips.hook: YOUR COFFEE JUST PAID YOU BACK IN BITCOIN
script: POV: you buy the same coffee you buy every single morning, except this time it pays you back.
This is Fold. It's a debit card and an app that gives you bitcoin rewards on stuff you're already buying.
Coffee, gas, groceries, that random Target run. Swipe the card, and a little bitcoin shows up in the app.
You can also grab gift cards for brands you already shop at right inside Fold, and those earn rewards too. Rates vary by brand.
No charts, no crypto homework. Just your normal spending, quietly adding up.
Rewards aren't a deposit and can lose value, but if you're spending anyway, it's a pretty easy switch.
brand_clips.caption: Your morning coffee, but it gives you bitcoin back. #fold #bitcoin #cashback #personalfinance

brand_clips.hook: POINTS VS BITCOIN REWARDS. BE HONEST.
script: Be honest. When was the last time you actually used your credit card points?
They sit there, they expire, and half the time you need a math degree to redeem them.
Fold does rewards differently. You spend like normal, and you get rewarded in bitcoin instead of points.
It shows up in the app as real bitcoin that you own. You can hold it, or sell it back to dollars whenever you want.
I'm not here to tell you bitcoin rewards beat points. That's not the point.
The point is they're simple. Swipe with Fold, get bitcoin, done. Rewards aren't a deposit and can lose value, but at least I understand them.
brand_clips.caption: Points vs bitcoin rewards. Which one do you actually use? #fold #bitcoin #creditcardpoints #moneytips

brand_clips.hook: BITCOIN FOR PEOPLE WHO DON'T GET BITCOIN
script: If bitcoin feels confusing, this is the simplest way I've seen to start.
Fold is an app with a debit card. You use it like any other card, and it rewards you with small amounts of bitcoin.
No exchange, no seed phrase, no YouTube rabbit hole. It's just there in the app.
Want more than the rewards? You can buy bitcoin right in Fold too, a few dollars at a time, and even put it on autopilot.
Lose the card? Lock it in two taps. Everything lives in one place.
Bitcoin has ups and downs and rewards can lose value, so start small. But start simple. That's the whole idea behind Fold.
brand_clips.caption: Bitcoin, minus the homework. #fold #bitcoin #bitcoinforbeginners #moneytips
